# djs-core

> Type-safe Discord bot framework built on discord.js

## Docs

### Getting Started

- [djs-core](/index.md): Type-safe Discord bots with file-based routing
- [Installation](/getting-started/installation.md): Get started with djs-core
- [Project Structure](/getting-started/project-structure.md): How djs-core organizes your bot's code
- [Routing](/guides/routing.md): File paths → command names and component customIds
- [Configuration](/essentials/configuration.md): djs.config.ts, intents, db, plugins

### Interactions

- [Overview](/interaction/index.md): Slash commands and context menus
- [Commands](/interaction/commands.md): Create slash commands
- [Context Menus](/interaction/context-menus.md): User and message right-click menus
- [Event Listeners](/interaction/events.md): Discord gateway events

### Components

- [Overview](/components/index.md): Buttons, modals, and select menus
- [Buttons](/components/buttons.md): Button interactions
- [Modals](/components/modals.md): Modal forms and submissions
- [Select Menus](/components/select-menus.md): All select menu types

### Data

- [Database](/essentials/database.md): Native Drizzle with client.db
- [Migrate from plugins](/guides/migrate-db-plugins.md): Move off deprecated DB plugins

### Production

- [Bundle](/bundle/index.md): Build and deploy your bot

### Extensions

- [Plugins](/essentials/plugins.md): definePlugin and lifecycle hooks
- [Plugin Marketplace](/plugins-marketplace.md): Legacy official plugins (deprecated DB plugins)

### Experimental

- [Cron Tasks](/essentials/events-tasks.md): Scheduled background tasks
- [User Config](/essentials/user-config.md): config.json with typed client.config

### Tooling

- [CLI Reference](/guides/cli.md): All djs-core dev commands
- [Lint](/essentials/check.md): djs-core check rules
- [Testing](/essentials/testing.md): @djs-core/testing and bun:test
